401-2530-3944-6794.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-6794.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

2781-2947-4247.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Vesperlark.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

586-1594-3899-5258-5618.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-6720.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1594-4399-4770-6752.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Haliya trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4770-6752.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
without summoning sickness and with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

3259-4478-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-4478-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

81-3099-4762-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Shang-Chi and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1308-4050-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-4050-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2149-2440-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Zaffai
1618-2149-2440-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Zaffai triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2149-2440-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Zaffai. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

855-997-1806-2060-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4742-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2034-3991-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

104-851-2034-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-851-2034-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2981-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3095-3652-6871.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters, Overburden triggers, causing you to return Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

2187-3647-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2187-3647-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Possessed Skaab and Peregrine Drake
When Possessed Skaab and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
2187-3647-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

1844-2034-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
1844-2034-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

1018-2730-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skullwinder, adding {B}.
When Skullwinder dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Skullwinder.
Repeat.

527-542-5295.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

759-1114-1247-5963-6549.description:
Activate Wrenn and Realmbreaker's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Grove of the Burnwillows to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

573-1399-1606-5929.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gruul Turf.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

654-1479-5700-5701-6517.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-5700-5701-6517.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

731-790-3862.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
731-790-3862.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

1621-3563-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
1621-3563-4605.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

1429-3698-4875-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-3698-4875-5402.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2724-2921-3194-3582.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

2430-3075-5195.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four experience counters.
2430-3075-5195.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1170-2450-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Gilded Lotus.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

2-1283-1651-5051.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping Traxos and Ancestral Statue, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, if you control a colored permanent, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1295-2503-2726.description:
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Relfections of Littjara triggers, creating a token copy of Inverter of Truth.
The Inverter of Truth token enters the battlefield, exiling your library face down and shuffling your graveyard into your library.
The nontoken Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, exiling your library face down.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

1283-4028-4222.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
1283-4028-4222.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Freed from the Real for {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

uses.n: Journey to Eternity // Atzal, Cave of Eternity

1888-2438-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Journey to Eternity attached to Palimchron.
You must control six lands which can produce 4BG.
1888-2438-2792.description:
Sacrifice Great Whale to Carrion Feeder.
Return Great Whale to the battlefield, and return Journey to Eternity transformed into Atzal, Cave of Eternity.
Untap lands sufficient to produce 4BG.
Produce 4BG without activating Atzal.
Sacrifice Great Whale to Carrion Feeder.
Activate Atzal's second ability, targeting Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, untap Atzal and other lands sufficient to produce 4BG.
Produce 4BG without activating Atzal.
Repeat.

224-573-872.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.
